title: Existence of normalized slice tensor, Hom and Koszul comparisons
statement: For a site J small relative to the module universe, a commutative ring sheaf A, and U in the site, fix the independent-universe derived internal Homs and exact slice restriction. Fix closed tensor-Hom structures S and S_U together with their canonical K-flat tensor and uncurrying models [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. There exists comparison data d as in [def-sfb-ringed-slice-comparison-model] satisfying all four representative normalizations: pure-tensor restriction with its localization square, local Hom-family restriction with its fixed K-injective augmentation square, and the source and slice Koszul formulas. No evaluation or transposition compatibility is asserted here.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 08JB, 08FI and 03EL; the tensor and Hom comparison constructions, and the signed total-complex exchange.

proof.text: Apply the proved exact slice K-flat preservation theorem to P. To preserve flat terms, use the local equational criterion: a relation at V over U is the same relation at V.left, and a covering sieve and its witnessing solutions restrict through Sieve.overEquiv. This proves RingedSliceFlatRestriction without resolving any complex.

source.place: Tag 0E8K, lemma-restriction-K-flat; flatness by local relations.

proof.text: Take the ordinary natural total-tensor comparison gamma from [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-slice-total-tensor-comparison]. Restriction induces a functor F on the full K-flat subcategories by the preceding preservation result. Let L be K-flat inclusion followed by Q; it is a localization by the proved kFlatLocalization helper of [lem-sf-ringed-derived-tensor-hom-adjunction]. On the product K-flat category compose T.comparison.symm whiskered by r, the localization factor alpha, Q(gamma), TU.comparison, and the inverse of SU.tensor applied to alpha in each argument. Fully faithful whiskering along L product L descends this natural isomorphism to rho. The preimage equation on (P,Q), precomposed with r(T.iso.hom) and postcomposed with SU.tensor(alpha.hom,alpha.hom), gives exactly the tensor model square by cancellation of the inverse isomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 07A4; ordinary total comparison descended along K-flat presentations.

proof.text: Take eta with its fixed augmentation and local-family normalizations from the now proved [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-slice-hom-comparison-existence]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-koszul-existence] on the source and slice to obtain sigma and sigmaU with their model squares and pure Koszul formulas. A private generic constructor over two categories assembles the components of rho, eta, sigma, sigmaU, their naturality equations and flat restriction into RingedSliceEvaluationComparisons. The four proved normalization statements give the required inhabitant of the subtype.

source.place: Tags 08JB, 08FI and the signed total-tensor exchange.

proof_origin.place: Tags 07A4, 08JB, 08FI and 0E8K. K2: descend the ordinary total comparison through the proved K-flat localization, prove flat-term preservation by local relations, transport the native Koszul symmetry to arbitrary specified tensor models, and assemble with the normalized Hom comparison. No unit route is replaced. B2, 2026-10-26: complete the existing total-tensor and Hom comparison obligations using their actual chain constructions; retain this assembly and abstract its record constructor. No further split or unit-route change.

theorem ringedSlice_normalizedComparisons
    (U : C) [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (SheafOfModules.{max c v u} ((sheafCompose (J.over U) (forget₂
      CommRingCat.{max c v u} RingCat.{max c v u})).obj (A.over U)))]
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A))
    (T : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, c, v, w} J A S)
    (SU : CoefficientClosedStructure
      (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U)))
    (TU : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, max c v, v, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U) SU) :
    Nonempty {d : RingedSliceEvaluationComparisons (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A)
      (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U))
      (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U) S SU (RingedSliceFlatRestriction.{c, v,
      u} J A U) // RingedSliceEvaluationNormalized.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U S T SU TU d}
